title: 7.1 File Uppercase
prompt: 7.1 Write a program that prompts for a file name, then opens that file and reads through the file, and print the contents of the file in upper case. Use the file words.txt.

student.py.starter:
# Use words.txt as the file name
fname = input("Enter file name: ")
fh = open(fname)
student.py.solution:
# Use words.txt as the file name
fname = input("Enter file name: ")
fh = open(fname)
text = fh.read().strip()
print(text.upper())
